title: Best selling product by month
statementMd:
For each month of 2024 that has non-cancelled sales, show the product with the most units sold (month, product name, units). Break ties by product name.

Expected columns: `month`, `name`, `units`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Group by month and product, rank with `ROW_NUMBER` ordered by units desc then name.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY month, p.id), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY units DESC, name) AS rn FROM m) SELECT month, name, units FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY month;
```
